sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 483 No. - 2379 of 2024
Applicant :- Ziba Khan

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others Counsel for Applicant :- Ram Raksha Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Ms. Nand Prabha Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The present application u/s 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with prayer to direct the Trial Court to decide the trial of Case No.3840 of 2020 (State v. Imran Khan and others), arising out of Case Crime No.0015 of 2020, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibtion Act,
within stipulated period.

entities.text: Case No.3840 of 2020 (State v. Imran Khan and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the matter is pending consideration before the court concerned.
Expeditious disposal of a case is the right of every litigant and it is expected from every Court to endeavour to dispose of a case pending before it, expeditiously.
Learned A.G.A. has no objection in this regard.
Ziba Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/124786065/

entities.text: Ziba Khan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and submission made by learned counsel for applicant, it is expedient to direct the court concerned to make its endeavour to decide the case as expeditiously as possible without granting any unnecessary or long adjournments to either of the parties, if there is no other legal impediment.
With the aforesaid directions, the application stands disposed of finally.
